context: Scrollytelling network growth visualization — five staged steps revealing how a network evolves from a founder clique to a mature 65-node graph, with sticky force-directed SVG on the right and narrative text on the left.
first_impression: Polished two-column scrollytelling layout with clear typographic hierarchy and a deliberate colorblind-safe palette, though the network renders small in early stages leaving the sticky panel feeling underused.
what_works: The Tol colorblind-safe palette is an intentional, principled choice — not a default. Typography is genuinely hierarchical: small-caps stage label with letter-spacing, bold dark title, muted body text, and a monospaced stat badge create a clear reading order.
what_doesnt: In Stage 1 the five founder nodes cluster into a ~100px patch at the center of a 660×620 canvas, leaving vast empty whitespace that makes the visualization feel timid rather than confident. The fixed progress dots at left:16px physically overlap the scroll column text, creating a layout collision visible in the rendered output.
